Allows you to move while concealing your presence from zombies.
Rate at which Stealing skill levels up. (Global Multiplier must be unchecked)
Rate at which Stealth skill levels up. (Global Multiplier must be unchecked)
Enables world spawn for Thief Books.

The Legend of Wiv, the Thief Who Lived in Britannia.
It is said that everything about her mastery of stealth is recorded here...

You must wait to perform another action.
A button to attempt stealing will be shown on the screen. Requires restart after changing.
A "Steal" command will be shown in the context menu.
A button to toggle stealth mode will be shown on the screen. Requires restart after changing.
A "Hide" command will be shown in the context menu.
You can adjust the sound volume when stealing is fumbled.
You can adjust the sound volume when stealing succeeds.
You can adjust the sound volume when stealth is off.
You can adjust the sound volume when stealth is on.

You can change the character's transparency when stealth is active.
0=Fully transparent 10=No transparency

You fail to steal the item.
You must be standing next to the target to steal it.
Trying to steal while still in the car, are you?
You can't seem to hide right now.
Can steal, stealth move, and hotwire vehicles. Less chance of breaking window locks.
